risks.title: High dependence on major customers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Our Industry, Operations, and Competition', language is strong ('substantial negative impact', 'material adverse effect'). Concentration on 2 customers representing 40% of sales in 2025 is significant. This risk is weighted under the 'Competition' category as customer loss may relate to competitive pressures.

risks.title: Intense price competition and margin pressure
risks.score_rationale: Highlighted in 'Our Industry, Operations, and Competition' with strong language ('intense price competition', 'material adverse effect'). Pricing pressure and the need to maintain a competitive cost structure are central. The 'Competition' category is most relevant.

risks.title: Supply chain and supplier risks
risks.score_rationale: Described in 'Our operations may be materially and adversely affected if our suppliers fail to perform or if we cannot manage our supply chain effectively.' Language is strong ('materially adversely affect'). Dependence on foreign suppliers (77% of purchases) and geopolitical risks (tariffs, instability) are significant.

risks.title: Impact of inflation and logistics costs
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Significant inflation could adversely affect our business and financial results' and 'Our operating results are sensitive to the availability and cost of third-party logistics providers'. Language is strong ('materially adversely affect'). Inflation in input and transportation costs is a major risk.

risks.title: Changes in vehicle quality and warranties
risks.score_rationale: Presented in 'Our Industry, Operations, and Competition' with clear language ('negatively impacted', 'material adverse effect'). Improved quality of new vehicles and extended warranties reduce demand for replacement parts. This risk is industry-specific as it directly affects the core business.

risks.title: Risks related to excessive customer returns
risks.score_rationale: Described in 'Our profitability may be materially adversely affected by customer overstock returns exceeding anticipated levels'. Language is strong ('materially adversely affected'). Returns of non-defective products can significantly impact profitability if provisions are exceeded.

risks.title: Impact of U.S. trade policy changes (tariffs)
risks.score_rationale: Addressed in 'Changes in U.S. trade policy, including tariffs and related actions, could adversely affect our business and results of operations'. Language is strong ('adversely affect'). High reliance on Chinese suppliers (38% of purchases) makes the company vulnerable to customs tariffs.

ai_positioning.summary: The company DORM does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
